## Data roots also present in the context

`children`, `client`, `college`, `dpoa`, `execution`, `family`, `ferpa`, `healthcare`, `hipaa`, `minor_children`, `outright_will`, `pour_over`, `state`, `trust`, `will` — see fields.md for their fields. Note the context defaults several nested values (e.g. `will.pr_structure` → `single`, `will.bond` → `no_bond`, `will.utma_age` → `21`), and aliases display fields:

| Execution field | Empty-payload default |
|---|---|
| `execution.display_doc_date` | `________________, 20___` | 
| `execution.display_notary_commission` | `__________________________` | 
| `execution.display_ordinal_doc_date` | `_____ day of _________________, 20___` | 
| `execution.display_signing_county` | `__________________________` | 
| `execution.doc_date` | `________________, 20___` | 
| `execution.notary_commission` | `__________________________` | 
| `execution.ordinal_doc_date` | `_____ day of _________________, 20___` | 
| `execution.signing_county` | `__________________________` | 

- `execution.display_doc_date`: Falls back to a blank fill-in line (`________________, 20___`) when no signing date is scheduled. Raw `execution.doc_date` is aliased to this display value for legacy templates — always write `display_*` in new work.
- `execution.display_signing_county`: Same display/raw aliasing as `display_doc_date`, with a blank-line fallback.
- `execution.display_notary_commission`: The only optional placeholder (`| optional` renders empty rather than `[[ MISSING ]]`).
